title: Card Play
subtitle: Learn together, one card at a time
emptyHint: Paste words and definitions to make your first set.
noClassSets: No sets assigned to this class
noClassSetsHint: Choose a set from My sets and add it to your class.
pasteHint: Copy cells from a spreadsheet and paste them, or import a CSV/TSV file. .xlsx files cannot be uploaded directly. Columns: front, back, optional example, optional alternative answers. Up to 200 cards.
pastePlaceholder:
apple	an edible fruit
a book	printed pages
previewHint: Preview practice does not save student progress.
saveHint: Save your set, then assign it to your class. Editing a set keeps existing assignments unchanged.
required: Enter a title and fill in the front and back of every card.
emptyCell: Both front and back are required.
tooLong: The text or card count exceeds the limit.
fileError: Choose a UTF-8 CSV/TSV file under 250KB.
noDistributions: This set has not been assigned to your class yet.
noStudents: Add students in class management first.
studyHint: Use 0 for optional practice. The card count equals one full round. Memorize counts cards marked as learned, Recall and Spell count correct responses, and repeating the same card alone cannot fill the requirement.
publishHint: This assignment keeps a snapshot of the cards, so later edits to the set are not added. Assigning to all students includes students who join later; selected students only reach those students. Use After the deadline to keep study open, mark it late, or close it.
error: Could not complete the request. Please try again.
session: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
forbidden: This resource is unavailable or you do not have access.
name: Name
reportHint: Study counts and test scores are recorded separately from game points and growth rewards.
emptyFolderHint: Move the sets out of a folder before deleting it.
chooseMode: Choose a learning mode to preview
archivedHint: Restore this archived set before assigning it.
renameHint: Select a folder to rename or delete it.
hardWordsHint: The rate is the share of students with any activity who missed this card.
editHint: Change the study rules and deadline. The cards and existing study records stay as they are. Test settings apply to tests started from now on; a test in progress is graded as it was started.
includeNewStudents: Open to all students, including new ones
duplicateFronts: Some cards have the same front. Remove duplicates keeps only the first of each.
teamGameHint: The whole class plays this set in teams. Opening a room puts a code on the board; students join with the code or the QR.
teamChoiceOnly: Multiple choice only. The server builds the choices from the other cards in this set.
teamTooFew: This needs at least 2 cards with different answers. Without them there are no wrong choices, so a team game can't open.
teamJoinHint: Students type the code on their Card Play page or scan the QR.
teamReviewWrong: {wrong} of {total} who answered got it wrong
teamReviewClean: No missed questions. Everyone knew these!
